description: This file implements functions for handling HTTP chunked transfer encoding in a web server, including appending chunks, handling range requests, and decoding incoming chunked data.

methods.name: __attribute_noinline__ void http_chunk_len_append(chunkqueue * const cq,uintmax_t len)
methods.description: Appends the length of a chunk in hex format followed by CRLF to the chunkqueue, used for chunked transfer encoding.

methods.name: __attribute_noinline__ int http_chunk_len_append_tempfile(chunkqueue * const cq,uintmax_t len,log_error_st * const errh)
methods.description: Appends chunk length in hex to a temporary file associated with the chunkqueue.

methods.name: __attribute_noinline__ int http_chunk_append_read_fd_range(request_st * const r,const buffer * const fn,const int fd,off_t offset,off_t len)
methods.description: Reads data from a file descriptor within a specified range and appends it to the chunkqueue, used for range requests.

methods.name: __attribute_noinline__ void http_chunk_append_file_ref_range(request_st * const r,stat_cache_entry * const sce,const off_t offset,off_t len)
methods.description: Appends a reference to a file segment to the chunkqueue, handling chunked transfer encoding if needed.

methods.name: __attribute_noinline__ void http_chunk_append_file_fd_range(request_st * const r,const buffer * const fn,const int fd,const off_t offset,const off_t len)
methods.description: Appends a file segment to the chunkqueue using a file descriptor.

methods.name: int http_chunk_append_file_fd(request_st * const r,const buffer * const fn,const int fd,const off_t sz)
methods.description: Handles appending a file to the chunkqueue; reads into memory if small, or appends file segment directly.

methods.name: int http_chunk_append_file_ref(request_st * const r,stat_cache_entry * const sce)
methods.description: Appends a reference to a file to the chunkqueue, reading into memory if the file is small.

methods.name: __attribute_noinline__ int http_chunk_append_to_tempfile(request_st * const r,const char * const mem,const size_t len)
methods.description: Appends data to a temporary file in the chunkqueue, handling chunked encoding overhead.

methods.name: __attribute_noinline__ int http_chunk_append_cq_to_tempfile(request_st * const r,chunkqueue * const src,const size_t len)
methods.description: Steals a segment of a chunkqueue into a temporary file.

methods.name: __attribute_pure__ int http_chunk_uses_tempfile(const chunkqueue * const cq,const size_t len)
methods.description: Determines whether a chunkqueue's current content exceeds in-memory threshold and should use a tempfile.

methods.name: __attribute_noinline__ int http_chunk_append_buffer(request_st * const r,buffer * const mem)
methods.description: Appends a buffer to the chunkqueue, using tempfile if necessary, and handles chunked encoding.

methods.name: __attribute_noinline__ int http_chunk_append_mem(request_st * const r,const char * const mem,const size_t len)
methods.description: Appends a memory block to the chunkqueue, using tempfile if necessary.

methods.name: int http_chunk_transfer_cqlen(request_st * const r,chunkqueue * const src,const size_t len)
methods.description: Transfers a specified length of data from a source chunkqueue to the write queue.

methods.name: void http_chunk_close(request_st * const r)
methods.description: Finalizes chunked transfer by appending the terminating chunk.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ __attribute_noinline__ int http_chunk_decode_append_error(request_st * const r,const char * errstr)
methods.description: Handles errors during decoding of chunked data, logs error message.

methods.name: int http_chunk_decode_append_trailers(request_st * const r,const char * const mem,uint32_t len,buffer * const h)
methods.description: Processes and validates trailers after the last chunk, handling optional trailers in chunked encoding.

methods.name: int http_chunk_decode_append_data(request_st * const r,buffer * const mb)
methods.description: Decodes incoming chunked data, maintaining parsing state, and handles trailers at end.

methods.name: int http_chunk_decode_append_buffer(request_st * const r,buffer * const mem)
methods.description: Handles incoming chunked data received as buffers from backend.

methods.name: int http_chunk_decode_append_mem(request_st * const r,const char * const mem,const uint32_t len)
methods.description: Handles incoming chunked data received as memory buffers.
